facts.value: No proof through the Abitur certificate is accepted unless it explicitly states that unrestricted access to foreign universities is granted with the language acquisition.

facts.value: If B2 is specified, proof from the department (B2.1 or B2.2) or an equivalent to the DAAD Test can be submitted.

facts.value: If you do not speak the local language of the host country, it is recommended to acquire basic knowledge of the respective language, although this is not a requirement for application.

facts.value: If multiple language requirements are listed (e.g., B2/TOEFL/IELTS), they can be understood as alternatives, meaning you only need to submit proof of one of them.
